detailed_descriptions.en: AN EXPECTED HERO. A WORLD BEYOND IMAGINATION. You are Max Ventura , an ordinary delivery guy working for Megazon. When a dimensional rift tears through your warehouse, everything changes. You are pulled into Erath , a fantasy world tainted by ancient relics from Earth. Armed with the Quantum Glove and the powers granted by the Dimensional Guardians , you must journey across a realm of dragons, mutant creatures, and magic. Recover lost Earth artifacts, grow stronger, survive deadly traps, and uncover the truth about the First Chosen, a mysterious figure who failed the same mission long before you. PHYSICS THAT FEEL REAL. In EXD , your hands are your greatest weapon. Every object reacts with astonishing realism: feel the weight of the weapons you wield, the texture of every surface you touch, and the precision of full physical interaction. The Quantum Glove grants you telekinetic power. Summon fireballs between your palms, hurl ice spikes , and unleash devastating lightning bolts . You’ll feel the energy vibrate through your fingertips. UNCOVER POWERFUL WEAPONS. FACE YOUR ENEMIES. The world of Erath is filled with secrets. Survive traps, solve puzzles, and discover legendary weapons and artifacts, the Minar Alloy Blades , the Wands , and the Timelox , capable of slowing time itself. When your glove’s energy runs low, these relics become your lifeline against fully physical enemies. Undead hordes, mutant insects, Dragonids, and powerful wizards serving the Emperor will stop at nothing to keep you from cleansing Erath of Earth’s corruption. Explore every forgotten corner... and uncover treasures powerful enough to change your destiny. A FEAST FOR THE SENSES. EXD brings the world of Erath to life with breathtaking visual fidelity, inspired by classic fantasy artists Frank Frazetta and Boris Vallejo . Explore vast crystal caverns, witness stunning landscapes, and descend into ancient underground temples that will leave you speechless. The orchestral soundtrack evolves dynamically with your actions, sweeping melodies for exploration, intense arrangements for battle. With 3D spatial audio , you’ll hear the wind howl through the canyons, the roar of a creature behind stone walls, and the crackle of lightning surrounding you. A world so vivid, you’ll forget the danger lurking behind its beauty.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
AN EXPECTED HERO. A WORLD BEYOND IMAGINATION.

You are Max Ventura, an ordinary delivery guy working for Megazon. When a dimensional rift tears through your warehouse, everything changes. You are pulled into Erath, a fantasy world tainted by ancient relics from Earth.

Armed with the Quantum Glove and the powers granted by the Dimensional Guardians, you must journey across a realm of dragons, mutant creatures, and magic.

Recover lost Earth artifacts, grow stronger, survive deadly traps, and uncover the truth about the First Chosen, a mysterious figure who failed the same mission long before you.

PHYSICS THAT FEEL REAL.

In EXD, your hands are your greatest weapon.
Every object reacts with astonishing realism: feel the weight of the weapons you wield, the texture of every surface you touch, and the precision of full physical interaction.

The Quantum Glove grants you telekinetic power. Summon fireballs between your palms, hurl ice spikes, and unleash devastating lightning bolts.

You’ll feel the energy vibrate through your fingertips.

UNCOVER POWERFUL WEAPONS. FACE YOUR ENEMIES.

The world of Erath is filled with secrets. Survive traps, solve puzzles, and discover legendary weapons and artifacts, the Minar Alloy Blades, the Wands, and the Timelox, capable of slowing time itself.

When your glove’s energy runs low, these relics become your lifeline against fully physical enemies.
Undead hordes, mutant insects, Dragonids, and powerful wizards serving the Emperor will stop at nothing to keep you from cleansing Erath of Earth’s corruption.

Explore every forgotten corner... and uncover treasures powerful enough to change your destiny.

A FEAST FOR THE SENSES.

EXD brings the world of Erath to life with breathtaking visual fidelity, inspired by classic fantasy artists Frank Frazetta and Boris Vallejo.
Explore vast crystal caverns, witness stunning landscapes, and descend into ancient underground temples that will leave you speechless.

The orchestral soundtrack evolves dynamically with your actions, sweeping melodies for exploration, intense arrangements for battle.

With 3D spatial audio, you’ll hear the wind howl through the canyons, the roar of a creature behind stone walls, and the crackle of lightning surrounding you.
A world so vivid, you’ll forget the danger lurking behind its beauty.
